title: Xizmatlar
subtitle: Kerakli xizmatni tanlang. Narx, davomiylik va asosiy shartlar quyida ko‘rsatilgan.
questionsText: Batafsil ma’lumot olish yoki xizmatga buyurtma berish uchun telefon yoki Telegram orqali bog‘laning.

service-1.title: Texnik xizmat ko‘rsatish
service-1.description: Uskunalarni tekshirish, sozlash va texnik ishlarni bajarish.

service-2.title: Kunlik xizmat
service-2.description: To‘liq ish kuni davomida xizmat ko‘rsatish va kerakli ishlarni bajarish.

service-3.title: O‘rnatish
service-3.description: Kerakli uskuna yoki dasturni o‘rnatish va dastlabki sozlash.

service-4.title: Maslahat
service-4.description: Mutaxassis maslahati, muammoni tahlil qilish va mos yechim topish.

service-5.title: Individual xizmat
service-5.description: Mijozning individual talablariga muvofiq bajariladigan xizmat.
